title: Bram and the Inheritance
author: Mirabel Oyelaran
blurb: Ulyana Eastwick, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
